title: Orbital Hangar 01
subtitle: The zero-gravity docking sequence
line: You are a traveler in a lunar hangar, docking into a field of suspended eyewear where gravity has ceased to exist.
synopsis: You step into a cavernous metallic hangar where the air hums with low-frequency magnetic resonance. Above you, hundreds of sunglasses float in a state of perpetual freefall, held by invisible currents within a cold, brushed-aluminium chamber. The floor is a dark, matte graphite that absorbs all sound, forcing your movement to become a slow, rhythmic glide toward the center. As you reach for a frame, the surrounding glass walls ripple with soft pulses of white light, simulating the docking approach of a deep-space vessel.
quote: In the silence of the hangar, your gaze is the only anchor.

why.d: The narrow entry zone mimics an airlock, forcing the visitor to slow down before the hangar volume expands.
The hero display is positioned at the exact center of the room, requiring the visitor to circulate around it like a satellite.
The floating eyewear is arranged in an elliptical array to reinforce the sensation of an orbital trajectory.
Graphite floors contrast with the polished aluminium walls to heighten the illusion of a metallic spacecraft interior.

stops.sub: Weightlessness takes hold as the drift begins.
The light pulses in sync with my approach to the center.
The sunglasses float like stars in the hangar.
